title: Durability watcher (server)
note: There is exactly ONE durability watcher. Rows 23 and 44 are the same capability; lane F6 builds the pipeline-options UI on this API and lane F11 builds the workflow-supervisor skill on it.

watcher.pricingNote: Absent from web/src/data/models.json (154 entries), so it prices at $0 and project spend caps do not accrue for watcher calls. web/** is Team C's; the catalogue row is requested in INTEGRATION.md.

rescue.reason: There is no openai/gpt-5.6-pro. Three live ids carry the "GPT-5.6 … Pro" name, each with a 1,050,000 token context window. The name is ambiguous across three ids, so the shipped default is unset and escalation is disabled-with-reason until an operator chooses.

defaultModels.reconciliation: DEFAULT_COMPACTION_WATCHER_MODEL and DEFAULT_COMPACTION_REPAIR_MODEL (server/src/workflows/compaction-watcher.ts:13-16) are NOT a second source of default. Durability settings feed the watcher's existing watcherModel/repairModel parameters, which already take precedence over the KADY_* environment variables, which already take precedence over those constants. The constants are only reached when durability is switched off.

signals.label: Compaction
signals.observationSource: pi-packages/dag-fusion-drive/compaction-audit.ts (readTrustedDagFusionCompactionAudit), delivered by installDagFusionCompactionEventSink (server/src/agent/dag-fusion-bridge.ts) and consumed at server/src/workflows/context-watcher-production.ts:418-421
signals.firesWhen: a compaction occurred and one of its fingerprint checks failed (fingerprintFailure, server/src/workflows/compaction-watcher.ts:526-533)
signals.test: server/test/durability-signals.test.ts — 'fires compaction on a failed fingerprint check, and suppresses it when the toggle is off'

signals.label: Context rot
signals.observationSource: the watcher model's semantic verdict, parseCompactionSemanticVerdict (server/src/workflows/compaction-watcher.ts:317-368)
signals.test: server/test/durability-signals.test.ts — 'fires context-rot on the semantic verdict at the operator's watcher model'

signals.label: Hallucination
signals.observationSource: durable run events evidence_checked / gate_evaluated with data.supported === false (server/src/workflows/run-state.ts:1228-1257); plus a non-empty hallucinations[] in a semantic verdict
signals.firesWhen: an evidence check or gate reports an unsupported output
signals.test: server/test/durability-signals.test.ts — 'fires hallucination on an unsupported evidence check, and not when the toggle is off'

signals.label: Paused with no progress
signals.observationSource: durable run state: WorkflowRunState.status and .lastSeq via WorkflowStore.readRun (server/src/workflows/store.ts:2500)
signals.firesWhen: the run is paused, waiting, or blocked and lastSeq has not advanced for stallMs
signals.test: server/test/durability-signals.test.ts — 'fires paused-no-progress from real run state, and not before the stall time'

signals.label: Failed scripts and CI runs
signals.observationSource: durable run event node_failed (server/src/workflows/run-state.ts:1219-1223) on a node kind that executes an external process — lean4, which spawns at server/src/workflows/lean4-verifier.ts:439 and checks the exit code at :769
signals.unobservablePart: CI runs. grep found no CI integration anywhere in server/src; there is nothing to observe.
signals.test: server/test/durability-signals.test.ts — 'fires failed-script-run only for a node kind that runs an external process'

signals.label: Failed skill fires
signals.unobservableReason: Pi emits no skill-invocation event. A skill activation is inferred from a read of its SKILL.md and attached to a transient chat frame (server/src/agent/skill-label.ts:3-9, server/src/agent/events.ts:324); no skill success or failure is recorded in durable run state.
signals.apiBehaviour: GET /durability/signals reports observable:false with that reason; PUT /durability/settings refuses to enable it with a 400 and the same reason; lane F6 renders the toggle disabled.
signals.test: server/test/durability-settings.test.ts — 'refuses to enable a signal this build cannot observe, with the reason the UI shows'

insideTheAuthoritativeRunEventStream.meaning: a durability stop; distinguished from USER_CANCELLED and from run_failed

insideTheAuthoritativeRunEventStream.discriminator: unchanged from the pre-existing compaction path

runTimelineEvents.whyTwoPlaces: WORKFLOW_RUN_EVENT_TYPES is frozen in server/src/workflows/run-state.ts (lanes F2/F5) and each event type's data is validated against an exact key set, so a watcher observation has no legal slot there. Every state CHANGE still goes through the run event stream; only the watcher's own observations live in the journal, stamped with the run's lastSeq so a UI can interleave them deterministically. INTEGRATION.md carries the exact event types F2/F5 would add to fold the journal into the run stream.

lifecycle: The watcher owns no timer and no process. It rides ContextEngineeringProduction.startStoppedRunFeed (one unref'd interval that already existed) and is released by ContextEngineeringProduction.close, which server/src/index.ts already calls on shutdown. Proven in server/test/durability-lifecycle.test.ts (#41).
